name: Infinity Table
justification: Nice layer observation with a short implementation; the filling rule takes some reading without the figure.
solution_sketch: Layer m holds the numbers (m-1)^2+1 .. m^2: first m going down column m, then m-1 going left along row m. With m = ceil(sqrt(k)) and off = k-(m-1)^2, the cell is (off, m) if off <= m else (m, 2m-off).
